distractors.content: Project uses Docker Compose for local orchestration. Redis runs on port 6379 with default config.
To run unit tests with coverage in Deno: deno test --coverage=cov_profile && deno coverage cov_profile
Always prefer functional programming patterns and avoid mutating function arguments directly.
Grafana dashboards are provisioned at monitoring.internal.local on port 3000.
Kafka topics are partitioned by tenant_id using MurmurHash3 algorithm for uniform distribution.
